name: Data centre energy and water benchmarking (PUE/WUE)
applications: Design target setting for new campuses
Comparing cooling architectures and operating regimes
principle: Power usage effectiveness divides total facility power by IT power; water usage effectiveness divides water consumption by IT energy. Both are ratio metrics, so they say nothing about how much work the IT load does, and PUE in particular is dominated by climate, age and cooling architecture rather than by operator skill. The IEA notes cooling is about 7 percent of electricity in an efficient hyperscale centre but above 30 percent in a less efficient enterprise one, which is exactly the spread PUE is meant to expose.

process_steps.name: Meter IT load and total facility load separately
Compute PUE as facility power over IT power over a defined period
Meter water consumption and divide by IT energy for WUE
Report against the chosen protocol and boundary

key_equipment: revenue-grade power meters on IT and facility feeders
water meters on makeup and blowdown
DCIM or metering platform with defined boundaries

performance.basis: Uptime Institute 2025 survey: respondents' annual PUE had a weighted average of 1.54, and average PUE has hovered above 1.5 for years.

source.note: Uptime Institute Global Data Center Survey 2025 (31-page report PDF), text extracted and read 2026-11-14

performance.metric: average PUE, facilities commissioned within about five years
performance.basis: Uptime Institute 2025 survey: facilities commissioned from around early 2020 achieved an average PUE of 1.48.

performance.metric: average PUE, facilities of 20 MW and above
performance.basis: Uptime Institute 2025 survey: larger data centres of 20 MW and above averaged 1.44 globally; facilities in high latitudes in North America and Europe have PUEs of 1.3 or better.

source.note: Uptime Institute Global Data Center Survey 2025 (31-page report PDF), text extracted and read 2026-11-14

performance.metric: cooling share of data centre electricity
performance.basis: IEA: cooling is about 7 percent for efficient hyperscale centres and over 30 percent for less efficient enterprise centres.

source.note: IEA, Energy and AI, Energy demand from AI, read 2026-11-14

advantages: Common language for design targets, regulation and utility negotiation
Cheap to instrument relative to the savings it can expose
Exposes cooling-architecture spread that annual energy totals hide
limitations: PUE is a ratio to IT load and rewards load growth as much as efficiency
Values are not comparable across boundaries, climates and vintage without the protocol stated
Neither metric measures useful compute delivered per kWh
